description: NHFLOW hydrostatic semi-implicit on a curvilinear grid turned by 30 deg (G 50 2): the river reach of nhflow_3d_curv_river_kepsilon_rot30 (discharge inflow along the face normal, stage outflow, bed friction, k-epsilon). At 600 s the water level agrees with the explicit hydrostatic NHFLOW to 0.14 mm, the velocities to 3 mm/s.
covers: face lengths and normals of the geometry layer
gravity term of a cell from the open faces (mean normals per index direction)
